name: seis-test-flakiness
description: Analyze recorded local test results for flaky or nondeterministic patterns without rerunning tests.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze recorded test repetitions and failure variance.
interface.longDescription: Reads bounded local JSON test result records and reports tests with mixed pass/fail outcomes. It never reruns tests or claims a current build result.
interface.defaultPrompt: Analyze recorded test flakiness evidence in this local repository.
